P R O F E S S I O N A L E X P E R I E N C E 
 

Technical Delivery Manager · TCS India Apr 2026 – Present 
• Spearheading client discovery for new implementation requirements, driving project delivery management from day one in a 
software product delivery environment. 
• Compressed requirement-to-plan cycle by 20% through structured intake workshops, backlog grooming, and cross-functional 
stakeholder alignment sessions. 
• Leading coordination across Dev, QA, Business, and third-party vendors — maintaining sprint velocity tracking and delivery 
cadence reporting. 
 
Technical Project Manager · TCS Singapore (MUFG Bank Onsite) Jul 2020 – Mar 2026 
• Led end-to-end delivery of banking transformation programs with 99% on-time, zero-defect release rate across 12 production 
cycles — equivalent to running major product release trains. 
• Managed cross-functional squads of 15+ (Dev, QA, Business Analysts, Infra) achieving 25% productivity gain through sprint 
planning, backlog grooming, and team mentoring. 
• Drove executive stakeholder reporting cadences, regulatory submission packs, and escalation management — zero audit findings 
over 5+ years with MAS-regulated programs. 
• Designed and introduced automation dashboards replacing manual monitoring — reducing operational overhead by 30% and 
improving real-time project visibility for senior leadership. 
• Coordinated vendors and business partners to align delivery timelines, manage dependencies, and resolve blockers proactively — 
sustaining 40% fewer SLA breaches. 
 
Technical Lead · TCS Gurgaon 2016 – 2020 
• Directed 8-member engineering team delivering zero-defect releases on mission-critical core banking applications processing 1M+ 
daily transactions. 
• Mentored 3 junior leads into senior roles — building a sustainable talent pipeline and reducing key-person dependency by 35%. 
• Streamlined release cycles in collaboration with business stakeholders — cutting average release window by 15% with zero 
production rollbacks. 
• Automated monitoring processes via custom dashboards, reducing manual effort by 30% and increasing STP ratio by 20%. 
 
Module Lead – NEFT / RTGS · TCS Onsite, Jaipur 2013 – 2016 
• Led NEFT/RTGS payment module as primary SME — ensured 99.9% transaction uptime and full RBI compliance across all 
production cycles. 
• Automated payment monitoring via centralized dashboards, boosting STP ratio by 20% and reducing reconciliation effort 
significantly.

Vietnam NAPAS API Integration · MUFG Bank (Onsite) Mar 2025 – Mar 2026 
• Led NAPAS API integration for MUFG Bank's Vietnam branch, adding a new customer payment channel and improving transaction 
efficiency — analogous to a product feature launch in a regulated environment. 
• Developed configurable channel parameters and robust exception handling / cutoff management protocols, reducing processing 
errors and improving operational resilience. 
 
Beneficiary Name Lookup — India Regulatory · MUFG Bank (Onsite) Jan 2025 – Mar 2026 
• Delivered RBI-mandated Beneficiary Name Lookup Facility — streamlined account verification across all Indian banks, enhancing 
transaction security and customer trust. 
• Coordinated cross-functional teams for seamless integration, testing, and validation — reducing transaction errors and meeting 
regulatory go-live deadlines. 
 
NEFT/RTGS ISO 20022 Migration · MUFG Bank (Onsite) Mar 2024 – Nov 2025 
• Led migration from plain-text to XML-based ISO 20022 message format — end-to-end testing with beneficiary banks, managing 
STP/NSTP flows and comprehensive return handling. 
 
SMILE to T24 Core Banking Migration · MUFG Bank (Onsite) Jan 2022 – Mar 2023 
• Directed full CBS migration from SMILE to T24 — developed booking request/response mappings, managed MQ queues, and 
handled multi-scenario response management for zero-downtime cutover. 
 
CBS Application — Rajasthan Co-operative Bank · Offsite, Jaipur March 2013 – Feb 2016 
• Built and maintained CBS application for 30 co-operative banks — integrating NEFT, RTGS, ATM services and HRMS, enhancing 
operational efficiency and transaction throughput.
